final: WITH filtered AS (SELECT ordersmark, remaincount FROM orderexecutions WHERE expirespot BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' AND ordersmark IS NOT NULL), per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remain, COUNT(*) AS exec_count FROM filtered GROUP BY ordersmark) SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS avg_of_avgs, SUM(exec_count) AS total_execs FROM per_order
